title: Real-time shipment tracking map for shippers (Project Atlas)
body:
As a shipper using the Lumen Freight portal, I want to see my in-transit loads on a live map so I can give my customers accurate ETAs without calling dispatch.

This is the headline feature of **Project Atlas**, our Q1 initiative to rebuild the shipper portal around real-time visibility.

**Acceptance criteria**

* Map shows every active load with the carrier's last GPS ping (updated at least every 2 minutes)
* Clicking a load shows origin, destination, ETA and assigned carrier
* Loads with stale pings (>30 min) are flagged in amber
* Works on desktop and tablet widths

**Notes**

* GPS data comes from the ELD integration (see telematics ingestion task)
* Design mockups are in the Project Atlas Figma file
author: Abraham AIProject
